text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc said Wednesday it lowered its rating for Methode Electronics Inc to long-term buy from strong buy because of diminished near-term earnings prospects.

-- Barrington Research said management sees problems ahead for auto connector sales compared to the strong sales over the last 12 months. The auto connector business is a very large and profitable part of Methode's business and will significantly reduce earnings, Barrington Research said.
-- Barrington Research also cited concern about sales at the Network Buss Division and Optoelectronics Division.
-- Its shares were off 7/16 Wednesday at 16-1/4.
